content: Our debiasing approach does not explicitly address the bias in the embedding layer. Therefore, we use gender-neutral occupations to measure the embedding bias to observe if debiasing the output layer also decreases the bias in the embedding. We define the embedding bias, INLINEFORM0 , as the difference between the Euclidean distance of an occupation word to male words and the distance of the occupation word to the female counterparts. This definition is equivalent to bias by projection described by BIBREF6 . We define INLINEFORM1 as INLINEFORM2
